# GroupDocs.Total for Node.js via Java examples

Package: @groupdocs/groupdocs.total
Pinned in Examples/package.json: 26.10.0
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@groupdocs/groupdocs.total
Docs: https://docs.groupdocs.com/total/

From Examples/:

- npm install
- npm start
- node run_all_examples.js --list

Node.js 20 LTS and JRE 8 or later.
Do not describe the dependency as latest.
